startPR.body:
## Status

- 🟢 LONG-only Cash Equity research contract / clean-205 split / Claude disposition aligned
- 🟢 Formal L0 acquisition, immutable-cache verification, PIT admission and one-command census path ready
- 🟢 Causal 1m→5m and Development-only L1 full-cross-section construction ready
- 🟢 L2 has one fixed causal feature set, one ridge model family, three predeclared targets, C-fit / D-select / C+D-freeze
- 🟢 Shared raw interface and four-stage integrated comparison/cash-ledger harness ready
- 🔴 Formal L0 remains data-blocked; J-Quants provider requests remain 0

## Frozen acquisition plan

| Item | Value |
|---|---:|
| Plan SHA-256 | `2a10ba6f49addaec91251cb5cb45ea1bcd21356b4c1c9d2bccc20f6aace7a258` |
| Evaluation sessions | 205 |
| Non-evaluation causal warm-up | 2024-09-09 Daily only |
| Daily requests | 206 |
| Dated Master requests | 205 |
| L0 minute requests | 0 |
| Base total | 411 |

The one extra Daily request is required to compute the adjusted close-to-close return for the first Development A session. It is not an evaluation session and cannot affect split accounting.

## Remaining acquisition blockers

Only three operational blockers remain:

1. Confirm the private non-Git cache destination.
2. Confirm `JQUANTS_API_KEY` presence in the intended runtime without observing its value.
3. Obtain separate operator approval bound to the exact Plan SHA, 411-request budget and authorized partitions.

The purge mechanism and storage contract are already implemented/tested; they are not additional per-request approval layers. The current Work runtime has no credential. This PR is not operator acquisition approval.

## Measurement path now ready

- `scripts/acquire_phase57_long_only_l0.mjs`: one-time immutable Daily/Master acquisition, including the causal warm-up.
- `scripts/run_phase57_long_only_formal_l0_from_cache.mjs`: verifies page and aggregate hashes, preserves all A/B evaluation sessions, then runs Formal L0 without manual stitching.
- `scripts/run_phase57_long_only_l1.mjs`: builds Development-only causal feature rows and separately hashed evaluator labels.
- `scripts/run_phase57_long_only_l2_development.mjs`: fits on C, selects the target on D, and freezes a C+D artifact without Validation/OOS.
- Existing shared replay and comparison interfaces keep one raw dataset reusable by Selector / Entry / EXIT / Allocation / Portfolio.

## Research protection

- L0 is Daily + dated PIT Master only.
- Intraday is acquired by released Development block and reused end to end.
- Future outcomes remain evaluator-only.
- Validation, Validation Replication, Primary OOS, Contingency OOS and Reserve remain sealed.
- Winner-only performance claims, outcome-based sampling, SHORT, margin and leverage remain prohibited.
- Completion remains Current Ark vs integrated cash-equity LONG-only under the same window and cost model.

## Verification

| Check | Result |
|---|---:|
| Focused LONG-only tests | 29/29 PASS |
| Full `predict/tests/*.test.mjs` | 2,608/2,608 PASS |
| Syntax / diff check | PASS |
| GitHub CI | 3/3 PASS |
| J-Quants provider requests | 0 |
| Safety flags | unchanged / all write and trading paths false |
| Lane Y / main / live circuit | untouched |

Detailed design: `docs/phase57-long-only-data-budget-and-dataset-split.md`
